metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.7 · 1931 · Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr Henry Frankenstein is obsessed with assembling a living being from parts of several exhumed corpses.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 7.8 · 1935 · Bride of Frankenstein
metas.description: Mary Shelley reveals the main characters of her novel survived: Baron Henry Frankenstein, goaded by an even madder scientist, builds his monster a mate.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 7.0 · 1939 · Son of Frankenstein
metas.description: Returning to the ancestral castle long after the death of the monster, the son of Dr. Frankenstein meets a mad shepherd who is hiding the comatose creature. To clear the family name, he revives the creature and tries to rehabilita...

metas.name: 4 · ★ 6.1 · 1942 · The Ghost of Frankenstein
metas.description: Dr. Frankenstein's plans to replace the brain of his monster are hijacked by his scheming and malevolent assistant Ygor.

metas.name: 5 · ★ 6.4 · 1943 · Frankenstein Meets the Wolf Man
metas.description: The resurrected Wolf Man, seeking a cure for his malady, enlists the aid of a mad scientist, who claims he will not only rid the Wolf Man of his nocturnal metamorphosis, but also revive the frozen body of Frankenstein's inhuman cr...

metas.name: 6 · ★ 6.2 · 1944 · House of Frankenstein
metas.description: A deranged scientist escapes from prison and recruits Dracula, Frankenstein's Monster and the Wolf Man to get revenge on his behalf.

metas.name: 7 · ★ 5.7 · 1945 · House of Dracula
metas.description: The Wolf Man and Count Dracula beg Dr. Edelman to cure them of their killing instincts but Dracula schemes to seduce the doctor's nurse.

metas.name: 8 · ★ 7.3 · 1948 · Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein
metas.description: The Wolf Man tries to warn a dimwitted porter that Dracula wants his brain for Frankenstein monster's body.

metas.name: 9 · ★ 8.0 · 1974 · Young Frankenstein
metas.description: An American grandson of the infamous scientist, struggling to prove that his grandfather was not as insane as people believe, is invited to Transylvania, where he discovers the process that reanimates a dead body.
